name: J. P. Small
role: Glendive cattleman handling the LC herd
bio: J. P. Small of Glendive came to Medora at the end of August 1885 to arrange the transfer of the LC cattle, though in September it was decided to leave the herd in the Bad Lands. He attended the April 1886 stock meeting with his son and at the end of August 1886 sold sixty head of LC cattle in Chicago.

J. P. Small and son, from north of the Yellowstone, attended the stock meeting.
J. P. Small returned Sunday from Chicago, where he marketed sixty head of LC cattle. They were in good condition, but only brought $3.25 on a descending market.
